newsitem.title: USA: Zoltek new carbon fiber capacity on track.
newsitem.headline: Zoltek new carbon fiber capacity on track.

text.p: Zoltek Cos Inc, responding to strong demand, on Thursday said it was on track to double its annual capacity to make carbon fiber in 1997.
The company said it expected to expand capacity by a total of five million pounds this year.
Chairman Zsolt Rumy said the increase would "more than double our current capacity, enabling us to serve a variety of new substantial users of carbon fibers."
Rumy said rapid growth in carbon fiber sales had strained existing capacity for the past two years.
Zoltek's objective is to increase its annual manufacturing capacity to more than 35 million pounds of carbon fiber by 2000. The materials are used as a reinforcement in composites.
Earlier, the company said earnings in its fiscal first quarter to December 31 doubled to $0.16 a share, while sales jumped 136 percent to $22.0 million.
